links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses versus sixth-grade benchmark across seven indices
links.effect: No model met the sixth-grade readability benchmark (P < 0.001); Gemini and ChatGPT were most readable, Claude and Perplexity most complex.
links.quote: No model met the sixth-grade readability benchmark (P < 0.001); Gemini and ChatGPT were most readable, while Claude and Perplexity produced the most complex text.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM chatbots answering common patient questions about Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome, assessing accuracy, readability, and presence of safety disclaimers without testing a specific organizational deployment intervention or safeguard.
